description:
For tls_mode='cf_strict': install a Cloudflare Origin CA certificate on the
    origin so nginx serves :443 and Cloudflare's Full(Strict) mode has a valid cert
    to connect to. Provide the cert + private key (create them in Cloudflare: SSL/TLS
    → Origin Server → Create Certificate, then paste both here or set them via env
    ZX_ORIGIN_CERT / ZX_ORIGIN_KEY). Re-renders the nginx site WITH the :443 block,
    verifies key↔cert, and reloads nginx. Run this BEFORE cloudflare_apply flips SSL
    to strict. The private key is never echoed back.
name: origin_cert_setup
